name: com.openworklabs/openwork
title: OpenWork MCP Gateway
description: One MCP URL for your OpenWork organization: org-assigned skills, plugins, workflows, and connections (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and MCP servers), exposed through search_capabilities and execute_capability.

install.claude-code: claude mcp add --transport http openwork https://api.openworklabs.com/mcp/agent
install.codex: codex mcp add openwork --url https://api.openworklabs.com/mcp/agent && codex mcp login openwork
install.gemini-cli: gemini mcp add --transport http openwork https://api.openworklabs.com/mcp/agent
